primary_result: The existing dataset inventory has a reproducible outcome-blind role ledger and sufficient unassigned known-overlap-quarantined capacity for a later, separately frozen development contract: ITS has 7,226 unassigned original-clear-scene units versus 3,215 required, and OTS has 6,419 versus 2,369 required, while preserving the 0.05 dB utility margin and 0.025 dB precision target.
gate_reasons: All six archived parent-evidence identity checks passed.
The complete official ITS and OTS clear-scene namespaces and authorized exclusions were reconstructed exactly.
Excluded, historically exposed, and unassigned scene roles form disjoint complete partitions in both strata and reproduce both frozen historical-selection digests.
Both strata exceed their simultaneous 95 percent assurance-adjusted independent-scene requirements.
competing_explanation: The favorable capacity result would be artificial if known overlaps, historically exposed scenes, duplicate clear targets, or nested haze variants were counted as fresh independent units; the qualified ledger excludes or labels those cases and uses only original clear scenes as independent units.
limitations: ITS and OTS are known-overlap-quarantined populations, not fully source-disjoint populations.
The remaining 574 unresolved ITS parent groups are not interpreted as non-overlaps.
ITS and OTS remain separate indoor and outdoor synthetic strata; no sample-size-weighted exchangeable pooling is authorized.
All 55 NH-Haze scenes remain development-only, and the 150 Haze4K candidate-confirmation scenes remain protected and unread.
This qualification did not train a model, run inference, decode image content, claim scenes for a future run, or estimate continuous utility.

The terminal authorizes only authoring a later typed development contract with frozen offsets, counts, estimand, gates, and data roles; it does not authorize measurement, model selection, confirmation, or deployment.
